name: Adventurer
blurb: No banner, no order, just grit and a willingness to go first. The guild starts here.

roleDescriptions.melee: No banner, no order -- just grit and a blade held steady up close.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Scouts ahead and picks fights from a distance no one saw coming.
roleDescriptions.caster: Self-taught magic, patched together from whatever actually worked.

name: Knight
blurb: Sworn, drilled, and reliable in a way freelancers rarely are. Cheap for what it brings.

roleDescriptions.melee: Sworn, drilled, and first through the door every time.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Trades the shield wall for a crossbow. still drilled, still reliable.
roleDescriptions.caster: Etches battle-runes into steel instead of casting from open air.

name: Dwarf Warrior
blurb: A wall with an axe. Almost impossible to put down, in no particular hurry.

roleDescriptions.melee: A wall with an axe, in absolutely no hurry to move.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Throws what it can't be bothered to carry into melee.
roleDescriptions.caster: Magic hammered into stone and metal, the old dwarven way.

name: Gladiator
blurb: Sword, net, and a bow for the ones that run. Fast and greedy for spoils.

roleDescriptions.melee: Sword and net, built for a fight that ends in one exchange.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Bow in hand for the ones smart enough to run.
roleDescriptions.caster: Arena tricks backed by whatever charm money could buy.

name: Samurai
blurb: One clean strike. Prizes a perfect kill and the rare blade it earns.

roleDescriptions.melee: One clean strike -- prizes the perfect kill over the messy one.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Trades the blade for a bow, patience unchanged.
roleDescriptions.caster: Wards and rites learned alongside the sword, not instead of it.

name: Witch
blurb: Hexes, bargains, and a nose for what a ruin is really worth. Fragile.

roleDescriptions.melee: A blade wrapped in a curse, for when the hex alone isn't fast enough.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Curses fired from a distance -- safer for something this fragile.
roleDescriptions.caster: Hexes, bargains, and a nose for what a ruin is really worth.

name: Lizardman
blurb: Scales, claws, and a swamp-born refusal to die. Little sense for coin.

roleDescriptions.melee: Scales, claws, and a swamp-born refusal to die.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Hunts from range the way its swamp taught it to.
roleDescriptions.caster: Old swamp magic, older than the guild that hired it.

name: Pyromancer
blurb: Answers every problem with fire. Devastating, and made of paper.

roleDescriptions.melee: A blade kept lit, for when fire alone won't close the distance.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Throws fire instead of casting it -- same result, longer reach.
roleDescriptions.caster: Answers every problem with fire. Devastating, and made of paper.

name: Wizard
blurb: Decades of study in a pointed hat. Unmatched on anything arcane.

roleDescriptions.melee: A blade wrapped in decades of study it never expected to need.
roleDescriptions.ranged: Trades the staff for something that hits from further away.
roleDescriptions.caster: Decades of study in a pointed hat, unmatched on anything arcane.
